title: client.destination (protocol v2)
description: Client -> server live-navigation target typed on the tablet (PROTOCOL_v2.md, Navigation). The server's phase1 provider (mock or Google Geocoding + Routes) resolves the query and builds the route from the next client.trip_state position; perception.hello navigation.destination echoes the current target. Same sender rule as client.trip_state.

query.description: Free-text place or address, e.g. "Piedmont Park, Atlanta".
